parts.text: Holy smokes. This is the bad place. Hello. How you doing?
Well hello there!  Things are going swimmingly here in the smart home. How can I help you make this *not* the bad place?
Great!  Let me know if you need anything.  I can tell you the time, get the weather, find some music, or even keep an eye on Felix if you'd like. Just let me know!
Hey there!  Anything I can assist you with today?
That's cool!  I'm always here if you need anything.  Want to set a chill mood with some music or check the weather?  Maybe I can even track Felix for you.  Just let me know what you'd like me to do.
Okay, cool.  Want me to put on some relaxing music?  I can do that.  Just say the word!
